paragraphs: The monster is following you.
You have to cross a bridge to survive.
The angry monster will catch up with you in 17 minutes.
Each member of your group moves at a different speed.
You are the fastest.
You can cross the bridge in just 1 minute.
The archer needs 2 minutes to cross, and the knight needs 5 minutes.
The wizard is the slowest.
She needs 10 minutes to cross.
You need to remember a few things.
It is so dark that you need the light from the magic stone to cross the bridge.
The bridge is not very strong, so only two of you can cross safely at a time.
All of you must reach the other side of the bridge in 17 minutes.
If you all get there, you can cut the ropes.
This way, the monster cannot follow you.
How can everyone cross the bridge in 17 minutes?
The answer is on the next page.
Take a moment to think before you check the answer.
Have you figured it out?
Then turn the page.
Here is the solution.
First, you and the archer take the stone and cross together.
It takes 2 minutes.
You come back alone with the stone in just 1 minute.
Now, 3 minutes have passed.
Next, the knight and the wizard take the stone and cross the bridge in 10 minutes.
Now, 13 minutes have passed.
Only 4 minutes are left, and you are on the starting side.
Now the archer takes the stone and returns to you in 2 minutes.
15 minutes have passed.
Finally, you and the archer cross together in 2 minutes.
That is it!
Now everyone is on the other side!
You quickly cut the ropes of the bridge.
Everyone is safe, and the magic stone is yours!

sentences.en: The monster is following you.
sentences.ko: 그 괴물이 / 너를 따라오고 있다.

sentences.en: You have to cross a bridge to survive.
sentences.ko: 너는 다리를 건너야만 한다 / 살아남기 위해서.

sentences.en: The angry monster will catch up with you in 17 minutes.
sentences.ko: 그 화난 괴물은 너를 따라잡을 것이다 / 17분 안에.

sentences.en: Each member of your group moves at a different speed.
sentences.ko: 너희 무리의 각 구성원은 / 서로 다른 속도로 움직인다.

sentences.en: You are the fastest.
sentences.ko: 네가 가장 빠르다.

sentences.en: You can cross the bridge in just 1 minute.
sentences.ko: 너는 그 다리를 건널 수 있다 / 단 1분 만에.

sentences.en: The archer needs 2 minutes to cross, and the knight needs 5 minutes.
sentences.ko: 그 궁수는 2분이 필요하다 / 건너는 데 / 그리고 그 기사는 5분이 필요하다.

sentences.en: The wizard is the slowest.
sentences.ko: 그 마법사는 가장 느리다.

sentences.en: She needs 10 minutes to cross.
sentences.ko: 그녀는 10분이 필요하다 / 건너는 데.

sentences.en: You need to remember a few things.
sentences.ko: 너는 기억할 필요가 있다 / 몇 가지를.

sentences.en: It is so dark that you need the light from the magic stone to cross the bridge.
sentences.ko: 너무 어둡다 / 그래서 너는 마법의 돌에서 나오는 빛이 필요하다 / 그 다리를 건너기 위해서.

sentences.en: The bridge is not very strong, so only two of you can cross safely at a time.
sentences.ko: 그 다리는 그다지 튼튼하지 않다 / 그래서 너희 중 오직 두 명만 / 안전하게 건널 수 있다 / 한 번에.

sentences.en: All of you must reach the other side of the bridge in 17 minutes.
sentences.ko: 너희 모두는 도착해야 한다 / 다리의 반대편에 / 17분 안에.

sentences.en: If you all get there, you can cut the ropes.
sentences.ko: 만약 너희 모두가 그곳에 도착하면 / 너희는 밧줄을 자를 수 있다.

sentences.en: This way, the monster cannot follow you.
sentences.ko: 이렇게 하면 / 그 괴물은 너희를 따라올 수 없다.

sentences.en: How can everyone cross the bridge in 17 minutes?
sentences.ko: 어떻게 모두가 그 다리를 건널 수 있을까 / 17분 안에?

sentences.en: The answer is on the next page.
sentences.ko: 정답은 있다 / 다음 페이지에.

sentences.en: Take a moment to think before you check the answer.
sentences.ko: 잠시 시간을 가져라 / 생각하기 위해 / 정답을 확인하기 전에.

sentences.en: Have you figured it out?
sentences.ko: 너는 그것을 알아냈는가?

sentences.en: Then turn the page.
sentences.ko: 그렇다면 페이지를 넘겨라.

sentences.en: Here is the solution.
sentences.ko: 여기에 해결 방법이 있다.

sentences.en: First, you and the archer take the stone and cross together.
sentences.ko: 먼저 / 너와 궁수가 / 그 돌을 가지고 / 함께 건넌다.

sentences.en: It takes 2 minutes.
sentences.ko: 그것은 2분이 걸린다.

sentences.en: You come back alone with the stone in just 1 minute.
sentences.ko: 너는 혼자 돌아온다 / 그 돌을 가지고 / 단 1분 만에.

sentences.en: Now, 3 minutes have passed.
sentences.ko: 이제 / 3분이 지났다.

sentences.en: Next, the knight and the wizard take the stone and cross the bridge in 10 minutes.
sentences.ko: 다음으로 / 기사와 마법사가 / 그 돌을 가지고 / 다리를 건넌다 / 10분 만에.

sentences.en: Now, 13 minutes have passed.
sentences.ko: 이제 / 13분이 지났다.

sentences.en: Only 4 minutes are left, and you are on the starting side.
sentences.ko: 오직 4분만 남아 있다 / 그리고 너는 있다 / 출발한 쪽에.

sentences.en: Now the archer takes the stone and returns to you in 2 minutes.
sentences.ko: 이제 / 궁수가 그 돌을 가지고 / 너에게 돌아온다 / 2분 만에.

sentences.en: 15 minutes have passed.
sentences.ko: 15분이 지났다.

sentences.en: Finally, you and the archer cross together in 2 minutes.
sentences.ko: 마지막으로 / 너와 궁수가 / 함께 건넌다 / 2분 만에.

sentences.en: That is it!
sentences.ko: 그게 전부다!

sentences.en: Now everyone is on the other side!
sentences.ko: 이제 모두가 있다 / 반대편에!

sentences.en: You quickly cut the ropes of the bridge.
sentences.ko: 너는 재빨리 자른다 / 다리의 밧줄을.

sentences.en: Everyone is safe, and the magic stone is yours!
sentences.ko: 모두가 안전하다 / 그리고 그 마법의 돌은 너의 것이다!
